fine_tuned.stale: Measured on the eval set before the 2026-10-06 leakage fix (15 rows were replaced); not re-run, so not comparable with 'base'.

note: Eval set rewritten 2026-10-06 to remove leakage into the training data. 'base' was re-measured on the new set. 'fine_tuned' (0.694) predates the fix and was not re-run; no fine-tuned head is shipped, laya_intent.py runs base Laya zero-shot. Run 2 (8 epochs, head lr 1e-3, frozen encoder); run 1 (4 epochs, lr 1e-4) left accuracy unchanged. The Docker image runs without Laya unless requirements-laya.txt is installed, so the default deployment is the classifier with the 0.4 confidence threshold.
